title: Compliance report pack generator service (MVP)
creator: Naomi Feldman
description:
Build the Compliance Report Pack Generator (MVP): assemble existing exports (audit logs, retention config, RBAC/access summary, residency/region summary), render a customer-ready package, and store/report versioning for repeatability.

Context
- This is the automation component behind the “baseline compliance reporting pack” used for enterprise security reviews (SOC 2/ISO-style evidence requests).
- Goal is to reduce Security/GRC + Sales Engineering manual effort by producing a standardized package on-demand with consistent versioning and provenance.

Primary users
- Internal: Security & Compliance (Olga Petrov), SecEng (Marcus Lin), Solutions Engineering (Markus Klein), CS (Rachel Kim)
- External: Customer security reviewers (delivered via secure share / portal download link)

Scope (MVP)
1) Job orchestration + API
- Create service: compliance-report-pack-generator
- API (control plane internal first; customer-facing later via Console):
  - POST /v1/compliance/report-packs: create generation job (tenant_id, time_window_start/end, template_id, output_format)
  - GET /v1/compliance/report-packs/{job_id}: job status + metadata
  - GET /v1/compliance/report-packs/{job_id}/download: signed URL (short TTL) or streaming download
- Asynchronous job execution (can take minutes depending on audit log volume).
- Idempotency key support: prevent duplicate jobs for same parameters within a short window (default 30 min) unless force=true.

2) Inputs to assemble
- Audit log export for time window (via audit-log-exporter with report templates/filters)
- Retention configuration export (current + change history summary)
- Data residency/region summary (tenant region + any allowed regions list; for Dedicated/Private include deployment mode + region)
- Access controls/RBAC report:
  - Current RBAC roles + user/group assignments snapshot
  - SSO status (if available) and break-glass accounts count (no secrets; only IDs + last used)
- Evidence checklist stub (links to internal procedure; customer version includes “how to interpret” and contact)

3) Packaging + rendering
- Produce a single “pack” as a zip containing:
  - manifest.json (pack metadata, versions, hashes)
  - audit_logs.csv (or jsonl) + readme
  - retention_config.json + readme
  - rbac_snapshot.csv + readme
  - residency_summary.json + readme
  - evidence_checklist.md (customer-facing)
  - compliance_report.pdf (PDF stub for MVP) OR compliance_report.html (preferred for initial rendering)
- PDF strategy (MVP): HTML template + headless Chromium render in worker. If PDF render fails, still produce zip with HTML and mark pack partial.

4) Versioning + storage
- Pack versioning:
  - generator_version (semver) and template_version embedded in manifest
  - schema_version for manifest.json
  - source_versions: audit-exporter version, retention-export version, control-plane build SHA
- Storage:
  - Write artifacts to object storage (S3) under tenant-scoped prefix
  - Encrypt at rest (KMS) and enforce per-tenant access controls
  - Signed download URLs expire in 15 minutes; require internal auth to request URL
- Retention:
  - Default store generated packs for 7 days (internal); configurable later (do NOT auto-store indefinitely)

Non-goals (MVP)
- Full custom report builder or customer-authenticated self-serve generation
- Deep GRC mappings (control-by-control SOC2 mapping) beyond the baseline checklist
- Arbitrary redaction policies; generator only consumes already-approved export views

Acceptance criteria
- Generate a baseline pack for a tenant for a given time window in < 10 minutes for 95p of typical enterprise tenants (audit export capped by paging).
- Pack includes manifest with deterministic hashing and clear provenance.
- Failures are partial where possible (e.g., PDF render failure does not block exports) and surfaced as warnings.
- Auditable: generator emits an audit event when a pack is generated and downloaded (actor, tenant, window, template_id).
- Security: only users with SecurityAdmin (internal) / appropriate tenant permission (future) can generate and download packs.

Links
- Confluence: /security-and-compliance/compliance-evidence/compliance-reporting-pack-baseline
- ADR: adr-018-compliance-report-pack-export-format
- Related PRs:
  - audit-log-exporter/pr-612 (time-windowed exports + filters)
  - audit-log-exporter/pr-627 (support retention config attachment)
  - redwood/pr-28526 (retention change history and export)

Open questions
- Confirm final “baseline pack” sections for MVP with Olga (GRC): include or defer “control mapping” appendix?
- Confirm whether we need separate templates per tier (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) vs a single template with conditional sections.
- Determine max audit log export size before we require partitioning or multiple files (proposal: split into 250MB chunks).
comments: 2025-02-12 (Naomi Feldman): This is the core automation for the enterprise report pack. Please keep output customer-ready but don’t block on perfect PDF—zip + HTML is acceptable for MVP as long as manifest + provenance is solid.

2025-02-14 (Kevin Osei): Drafted service outline. Plan is a small worker that calls audit-log-exporter with template_id + time window, then attaches retention config export from control plane. Will follow ADR-018 on export formats and versioning. Need final template fields from GRC.

2025-02-18 (Marcus Lin): Security requirements: (1) generator must emit audit events for generate + download, (2) signed URLs must be short-lived, (3) avoid including any raw prompt/completion content unless explicitly enabled for tenant (we should treat that as out-of-scope for baseline). Please include a “data included” section in README.

2025-02-21 (Olga Petrov): Baseline pack must include: audit log coverage summary (what event types are in scope), retention config export, data residency/region summary, RBAC report, and evidence checklist. Control mapping appendix can be deferred if the checklist is clear. Please make sure the pack has a “generated on” timestamp and the actor identity.

2025-02-25 (Sean Gallagher): Operational note—job should have a hard cap on audit export duration and size; emit metrics: pack_generation_seconds, pack_generation_failures, pack_generation_partial_warnings, pack_downloads. Also ensure backpressure so a single tenant can’t spam generation (rate limit).

2025-02-28 (Kevin Osei): Implementation in progress. Added manifest schema v0.1 with source hashes. Packaging uses zip stream to S3 to avoid large local temp. PDF render is best-effort; falls back to HTML on failure and sets manifest.warnings.

2025-03-03 (Allison Grant): Please align metric names with retention verification dashboards: use labels {tenant_tier, template_id, status}. Avoid tenant_id label for cardinality; use hashed bucket label if needed.

2025-03-05 (Kevin Osei): PR up for review: adds generator service + endpoints behind internal feature flag COMPLIANCE_PACK_MVP. Includes audit events: compliance.report_pack.generated and compliance.report_pack.downloaded. Waiting on audit-log-exporter/pr-612 to land in prod so time-window filters are available.

2025-03-07 (Naomi Feldman): Moving to In Review with requested changes: add “What’s included / What’s not included” README; ensure residency summary doesn’t overclaim (Hosted = region of processing + log storage region may differ).
